metaDescription: Orbase pili is a pili variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best. Compare it with others.
excerpt: Orbase is a registered pili variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2012 as NSIC 2012 Pl 12. Albay Expt. Station, Tabaco City bred it. Its record notes a yield of 3320 pcs. With 130.47 kilos.

items: **Yield:** a recorded yield of 3320 pcs. With 130.47 kilos.

blocks.text: When does it bear, and how much?

A registered tree variety is described from its mother tree, not from trial plots. The mother tree of Orbase was about 28 years old and about 11 meters tall when it was registered. Its record notes a yield of 3320 pcs. With 130.47 kilos. It bears all year, with fruit in July November. A grafted or marcotted tree bears years sooner than one grown from seed, and its yield climbs as the tree grows.

anee.io keeps the records of each block of trees, from fertilizer to harvest, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside them.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.
A fruit of Orbase weighs about 42.25 grams, and its shape is oblong. The flesh is black. Its fruiting season is July November, bearing year round.
Where and when to plant Orbase pili

Bicol grows most of the pili. Pick a registered selection by kernel weight and the share of kernel in the nut, and plant grafted trees, because seedlings can turn out male. A registered tree variety is a selection from one proven mother tree, and only grafted, budded or marcotted plants carry its traits. A seedling grown from its seed can turn out quite different. So buy from a nursery accredited by the Bureau of Plant Industry, and ask which mother tree the scions came from. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).
